items.title: 31.5 Petroleum ki fractional distillation aur refining (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of fractional distillation with Quick Check 31.3 and derived answers (PDF 225-226).

blocks.text: Crude oil (kacha tel) hydrocarbons ka complicated (pecheeda) mixture hai, is liye ise simpler (saada) aur useful hydrocarbons mein alag karna parta hai. Yeh separation physical tareeqe se hoti hai jise fractional distillation kehte hain; yeh different hydrocarbons ke boiling points ke farq par chalti hai. Is mein crude oil ko furnace (bhatti) mein itna garam kiya jata hai ke woh vapour (bhaap) ban jaye. Phir vapour fractionating column mein jata hai, jo aik ooncha tower (minar) hai jis mein oopar jate hue temperature ahista ahista kam hota jata hai.

Vapour oopar charhta hai, aur har hydrocarbon column mein us jagah condense (bhaap se liquid) ho jata hai jo us ke boiling point ke mutabiq ho. Heavier (bhari) hydrocarbons, jin ka boiling point zyada hai, neeche ke qareeb condense hote hain, aur lighter (halke) hydrocarbons, jin ka boiling point kam hai, zyada oopar tak jate hain. Is tarah crude oil se kaam ke fractions (hisse) milte hain, jo apne uses ke saath Figure 31.6 mein diye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Fractionating column, neeche sab se garam, furnace se hot vaporized crude oil (garam bhaap) aati hai; temperature bar oopar <20 C se neeche >370 C tak, aur chhe outlets (nikaas) fractions ke boxes tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 31.6: Crude oil (kache tel) ki fractional distillation se useful (mufeed) hydrocarbons (kitab ki Figure 31.6 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).
blocks.long_description: Lamba fractionating column, neeche sab se garam (red) aur oopar sab se thanda (light yellow), andar trays aur oopar jaate blue teer. Baen: temperature bar, oopar 20 C se kam aur neeche 370 C se zyada; crude oil input furnace se guzar kar hot vaporized crude oil (garam bhaap) ban kar column mein jata hai. Chhe outlets boxes tak: top of the column, Gases (e.g., LPG) <25 C, cooking aur heating; Gasoline (petrol) C8H18, <40 C - 200 C; Kerosene C10H22, 150-275 C, jet fuel, lamps; Diesel C14-C19, 250-350 C; Lubricating oils C20-C50, 300-370 C; Residue (bitumen) C20+, >370 C.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Column neeche sab se garam aur oopar sab se thanda hai. Vapour oopar charhta hai; har hydrocarbon us tray par liquid ban jata hai jahan temperature us ke boiling point se kam ho. Is liye chhote, light molecules (gases, petrol) oopar se aur bare, heavy molecules (lubricating oils, bitumen) neeche se nikalte hain. (Kerosene aur lubricating oils ke formulas ke liye neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' box dekhein.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 31.6 kerosene par 'C₁₀H₁₄' likhti hai, jo alkane ka formula (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂) nahi; 10 carbon wala alkane C₁₀H₂₂ (decane) hai, aur kerosene taqreeban C₁₀ se C₁₆ ke hydrocarbons ka mixture hai. Lubricating oils ko kitab C₁₅-C₂₀ likhti hai, jo taqreeban diesel (C₁₄-C₁₉) wali range hai; halanke lubricating oil column mein diesel se neeche jama hota hai aur us se bhaari hai, taqreeban C₂₀ se C₅₀. Is liye yahan C₁₀H₂₂ aur C₂₀-C₅₀ likha gaya hai.
Fractional distillation ahem hai kyunke is se petrochemicals milte hain jo industry, domestic (gharelu) aur transport ke kaam aate hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Agar fossil fuels non-renewable (dobara na banne wale) resources hain, to duniya bhar mein ab bhi itne zyada kyun use hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh energy ke bohat achhe zariye hain jin ki energy density zyada hai, aasani se mil jate hain, aur gariyan, bijli ghar aur industries inhi ke liye bani hain; yeh petrochemicals ka raw material bhi dete hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Kya XRD se kisi liquid ki structure maloom ho sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Usi tarah nahi. XRD crystal mein atoms ki regular (ba-qaida), repeating (dohrai jane wali) arrangement (tarteeb) par chalta hai. Liquid mein aisi lambi tarteeb nahi hoti, is liye sirf phaile hue blurred (dhundle) patterns milte hain; aam taur par pehle substance ka crystal banaya jata hai.

items: Fractional distillation crude oil ko boiling points ke farq se alag karti hai.
Column neeche sab se garam, oopar sab se thanda; bhari hydrocarbons neeche, halke oopar.
Fractions: gases, gasoline, kerosene, diesel, lubricating oils, bitumen.
